Enable experimental timeline tracks in the Remotion Studio. Group clips from `<Track>`, `<Series>` and `<TransitionSeries>` on shared rows, with overlays on additional rows. Disabled by default.

## CLI flag

```text
--experimental-tracks
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setExperimentalTracksEnabled(true);
```
